state:
Goal `core-math-2-3`: `Core\Math::exp`, `fdiv`, `floor`, `gcd`, `hypot`, `intDiv`, `isFinite`, `isNan` and `lcm` carry every feature proof — `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench and a `covers:` Rust test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/math.rs`'s test module — and their reference cards are rewritten in the plain voice.
Four members of the goal's `--only` list still owe proofs: `format`, `fromBase`, `log`, `max`.
The test module's helpers are `float_result` (a float member), `int_pair` (two `int`s, `Ok` or the thrown message), `bool_result` (one `float` in, a `bool` out) and `text_result`.
A rewritten card reaches `docs/novis.md` only after `cargo build` and `bun nv reference`; a perf figure goes stale when a member's code moves and is re-recorded with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only <ids>`.
No proof found a bug in these nine.
